d: Indonesia’s stock market turmoil has wiped billions of dollars from the fortunes of the country’s richest tycoons, as global index provider MSCI raises concerns over transparency, share ownership and suspected market manipulation. In this video, Firstpost examines how the threat of Indonesia losing its emerging-market status triggered a sharp sell-off, wiping around $65 billion off market value in a single session. The video looks at the losses suffered by major Indonesian billionaires, the risk of billions more flowing out of the country, and the reforms Jakarta is pursuing to restore…
